purpose: Pressure-test SILT against a real agentic-commerce legal-context payload without making LCP a canonical SILT carrier or legal ontology.

field_mappings.silt_treatment: May provide Evidence and may form part of Source where the relevant order gives the instrument or terms constitutive effect. It is not universally Source.
Proof/Evidence of document integrity and identity. It does not establish Standing, Authority, Consent, Binding or legal validity.
May express an encounter condition requiring explicit acceptance. It is not itself Consent.

field_mappings.lcp_element: signed acceptance record (LCP Level 3 advisory guidance)
field_mappings.silt_treatment: Evidence of assent/acceptance. Consent is evaluated under the relevant Source and Profile Expression; assent and Consent are not universally equivalent.
May inform a Profile Expression and downstream Binding analysis. The index does not itself establish applicability, jurisdiction or Binding.

May partially express encounter conditions comparable to a Profile Expression, or may remain operational policy below the Presentation line. Classification depends on whether it expresses semantic conditions or merely enforces them.
Complementary. SILT Authority is a semantic relation; credentials, mandates, signatures and capability artefacts may evidence/carry/enforce it but do not universally constitute it.
Treated as a downstream effect under applicable substantive conditions. SILT does not infer universal Binding from a signature or LCP level alone.

non_lossless_cases.lcp_gap: No native LCP concept for multiple coexisting normative expressions with no precedence rule. Adapter must preserve them outside the LCP terms index rather than collapse them.
No native LCP representation. It must remain outside evaluation or be signalled only through a SILT-specific extension without characterising the hidden condition.
LCP discovers terms and legal context but does not model Source -> Standing. A legal-context pointer must not be promoted into Standing.
LCP does not natively model contested collective authority to author encounter conditions. SILT provenance semantics remain separate.

adapter_rules: The adapter MUST NOT map LCP document integrity to Source sufficiency or Standing.
The adapter MUST NOT map signed acceptance directly to SILT Consent without an applicable semantic condition.
The adapter MUST NOT collapse multiple Profile Expressions into one LCP terms document merely for carrier convenience.
The adapter MUST preserve not-evaluated deliberate non-expression outside the three-valued outcome set.
Unknown-extension tolerance in the current LCP schema permits an experimental pointer field, but that does not make the SILT extension normative LCP.

pressure_test_result.publication_note: The mapping validates SILT's layer boundary but is intentionally partial. LCP is a legal-context discovery and agreement-record layer for agentic commerce; SILT remains the semantic layer for Source-grounded Standing, Presentation and encounter evaluation.
